# Runtime subset notices

The CRT and libc syscalls/mman/netdb retain their explicit GPL-3.0-or-later
file notices; the full GPL3 text is in LICENSE. All included headers retain
their original per-file terms. The following selected libc notices are also
reproduced here for binary-distribution materials. This index does not replace
notices in the corresponding source or other linked dependencies.
